title: doctor reports each Codex, OpenCode and Pi guard file it finds, in the project and in the home folder
source: intended: setup hook for every harness; doctor reports each harness file found (ok or warn)
intent: INTENDED behavior. The `hooks` and `hooks-user` lines keep their Claude Code text and append one part per other harness file found: a `.codex/hooks.json` read like the Claude settings (registered on the three slots is ok), a generated guard file with the jitso version of its marker (ok), a guard file without the marker (warn: jitso did not write it). A harness file never makes the line fail, and doctor still exits 0.

// generated by jitso v9.9.9: jitso setup hook; do not edit
const command = "jitso";
